name: Sheariah
title: Descendant of King Saul
summary: Sheariah was a descendant of King Saul through the line of Jonathan. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogies of the tribe of Benjamin, as a son of Azel. He was the father of six sons and belonged to the royal house of Saul.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shearia is listed as one of six sons of Asel in the genealogy tracing the descendants of King Saul through Jonathan.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: The same family line is repeated in 1 Chronicles chapter 9, confirming Shearia's place among Saul's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shearia belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, the tribe from which King Saul came, and his lineage was carefully preserved in the records.

keyEvents.title: Asel's Six Sons
keyEvents.description: Shearia was one of six brothers, sons of Asel. All six are named in Chronicles as part of the royal genealogical register.
